evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Declarative announcement of a decision controls the factual frame by stating the change as settled, supplying the fact itself rather than arguing for it.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch, framing benefits as offered gains to the audience.
Bolded migration label asserts the change as a documented fact, controlling the informational frame without invoking authority or inviting input.
Quantified performance claim presented as evidence supporting the decision — argument from data.
Bolded timeline fixes a deadline for the migration, applying time-based pressure on execution.
